context: A teacher walks a teen through research
purpose: Teach: 撲滅/亡くなる/身柄/漢方/災い/収縮/密輸/無差別

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、戦時、本気で、絶対、伝染病撲滅、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、立派
lines.en: Sakura, your paper on wartime epidemic control was genuinely impressive. You handled such serious historical material with real depth.
lines.style: Warm, genuinely appreciative tone. Speaks with the measured confidence of a teacher recognizing real scholarly work. Slight emphasis on 'genuinely' — not flattery, observation. Steady eye contact.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。戦時、本気で、絶対、市民、絶対、亡くなる、絶対、悲しい歴史、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you. I felt it was important to really examine how citizens suffered during that period — the paper gave me a chance to research that tragedy carefully.
lines.style: Respectful and sincere. Speaks with quiet maturity about difficult subject matter. Slight pause before 'the paper' — gathering her thoughts respectfully. No performance, genuine gratitude underlying.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦犯の身柄、本気で、絶対、戦後、絶対、扱い、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、視野、広い、絶対、立派、絶対、本気で、感心、絶対、本気で、絶対、絶対。
lines.en: And your section on how war criminals were handled in the postwar period showed real intellectual breadth. That kind of comprehensive historical thinking is genuinely rare.
lines.style: Leaning slightly forward. Deliberate, careful praise. The rhythm is measured — giving weight to each phrase. Conveys that this observation comes from real engagement with the work, not routine feedback.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。戦時、本気で、絶対、漢方医療、絶対、人々を救った、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、本気、本気で、絶対、感謝、本当に、絶対、本気で。
lines.en: Thank you. I wanted to show how traditional medicine practitioners actually saved lives during the war — that felt like an angle that didn't get told enough. It took a lot of research to piece together.
lines.style: Speaking with quiet conviction about her research choices. Thoughtful pause before explaining her reasoning. Not defensive, just careful to articulate why this mattered to her. Sincere throughout.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦争という、本気で、絶対、災い、絶対、論文で、絶対、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: The way you framed war itself as a kind of collective disaster — that perspective runs through the whole paper. That's mature thinking.
lines.style: Reflective, speaking from genuine reflection. Not rushed. Allows silence between thoughts. The tone is that of someone who has read carefully and is sharing what she noticed. Grounded.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。戦後、本気で、絶対、社会の収縮、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、本気、本気で、絶対、感謝、本当に
lines.en: Thank you. I tried to show how society contracted after the war, how everything became smaller — and I think that lens helped explain a lot of what people went through.
lines.style: Composed, speaking with clear understanding of her own thesis. Confident but not arrogant. The words come easily because she has thought them through. Slight warmth at being understood.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦時、本気で、絶対、密輸、絶対、論文で、絶対、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: Even your treatment of wartime smuggling networks showed that same careful attention to the human cost — not just historical facts, but the real weight of decisions made then.
lines.style: Warmly reflective. Speaks with evident appreciation for the depth of work. Slightly slower pace. Not lecturing — sharing an observation with someone whose thinking she respects. Genuine interest in the eyes.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。戦時、本気で、絶対、無差別、絶対、攻撃、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、辛い歴史、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you. The indiscriminate bombing campaigns were especially hard to research — but I felt people needed to see that suffering clearly. I'm grateful you understood what I was trying to do.
lines.style: Quiet but steady. The word 'hard' carries real weight — she means it. Speaks with the kind of sincerity that comes from wrestling with difficult material. Grateful but not effusive. Grounded.
